newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 400 METRES CHAMPION JOHNSON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 400 METRES CHAMPION JOHNSON.

text.p: Profile of Michael Johnson, who won the world 400 metres title on Tuesday.
Burst on to the world scene in 1990 with year's best times in both the 200 metres and the 400 metres.
Achieved a unique 200 metres-400 metres Olympic double last year in Atlanta, setting a world record of 19.32 seconds in the 200 metres final.
Granted a wild card for the world championships after missing the U.S. trials because of a quadriceps injury sustained during the 150 metres showdown with Donovan Bailey on June 1 in Toronto.
Had already won four world titles before coming to Athens, two for the 200 metres and two for the 400.
